status: Conditional trace-derived opportunity model, not measured speedup; no source/configuration edits or GPU runs.
scope: V2 plus BF16 expert cache, update21 rank0, three captured microbatches. First main layer means layers.0. Adopt the 1269.7101171875ms enclosing window from rs-overlap-native.json for comparability. No optimizer or remaining29microbatches measured.

model.mtp: Move513MiB FFN into early reduction; leave380.673828125MiB residual. Assume zero-intercept payload-linear durations and unchanged additive packing; early communication hidden by8.57-8.85ms remaining MTP. Use result from mtp-split-potential.json. Candidate callable readiness and all-rank readiness remain unmeasured.
model.layer0: Move513MiB FFN early; leave259.188232421875MiB residual. Assume zero-intercept payload-linear duration and unchanged packing; early communication fits6.33-6.37ms trailing layer. Use layer0-split-potential.json.
model.embedding: Replace all full forward weight gathers and full gradient reduce-scatters with row-owner route. Gross core model temporarily assigns zero cost to replacement routing, coalescing, communication and owner accumulation. Backward full weight gathers are already overlapped and receive zero direct step-time credit. Do not count.614494ms gaps as dependency-proven waits.
model.optional_pack: Existing full-table BF16-to-FP32 embedding gradient copy kernels sum3.367755ms. Full-owner route can replace these with compact row widening/owner accumulation; credit is optional gross budget only. Required dense local FP32 gradient, native BF16 local coalescing and rounding, optimizer, EMA and SAC/compile remain. New materialization/accumulation cost is not zero in an implementation.
model.combined_dependencies: MTP is separated in time from the final-layer/embedding tail. Layer0 is predecessor of embedding packing in the old shared-buffer path. Core model advances this tail once, then substitutes embedding communication once; no double count of existing main-stream overlap. A full-owner route removes that buffer dependency, so use max(residual_layer_reduction, embedding_gradient_ready_relative + row_route_elapsed) for the new tail rather than blindly summing isolated speedups. Formula and measured quantities in layer0-split-potential.json. The simple additive core is an optimistic gross screen with replacement cost omitted; exact changed critical path unknown.
model.formula: throughput_percent=100*(T/(T-saved_ms)-1). Net saving = gross opportunity minus exposed replacement/split costs, adjusted for newly exposed dependencies. Do not subtract work that remains fully hidden.
model.communication_screen: 14.742773ms MTP final contiguous gaps +6.839196ms layer0 no-main-kernel intersections +23.883292ms embedding forward gather and gradient reduction =45.465261ms. Broader than the FFN split model; not all gaps are causal waits or eliminable and no claim that this is a full implementation upper bound including compute/copies.

constraints: Preserve FP32 original/master parameters and FP32 cross-rank SUM/accumulation.
Preserve native source-local BF16 embedding coalescing/output rounding before widening every received row contribution to FP32.
Keep SAC, enabled model/loss compile, MTP, dense fusedAdamW, EMA, accumulation32 and checkpoint continuation.
unknowns: No positive lower bound or actual speedup established; regression possible.
NCCL kernel time may include peer waits; rank0 trace does not establish all-rank early readiness or payload-linear scaling.
Split compile/SAC may change launch count/fusion/recomputation, collectives count, memory and contention.
Row request/return/backward exchanges, metadata/dedup, owner skew/padding and FP32 accumulation costs are unmeasured.
Backward embedding weight-gather removal may reduce resource contention, but no extra speedup credited.
Extrapolation to full32microbatch update or productionPP4/EP32 is unsupported by this prefix.

WITH host AS (SELECT id,ts,track_id FROM slice WHERE name='GFSDP::all_gather (tok_embeddings)' AND category='user_annotation'),
 cpucomm AS (SELECT h.id AS host_id,c.id AS cpu_id,c.arg_set_id FROM host h JOIN descendant_slice(h.id) c ON c.name='nccl:_all_gather_base' AND c.category='user_annotation'),
 gpucomm AS (SELECT c.host_id,g.id,g.ts,g.dur FROM cpucomm c JOIN slice g ON g.category='gpu_user_annotation' AND g.name='nccl:_all_gather_base' AND EXTRACT_ARG(g.arg_set_id,'args.External id')=EXTRACT_ARG(c.arg_set_id,'args.External id'))
SELECT h.id AS host_scope_id,CASE WHEN h.track_id=2 THEN 'forward' ELSE 'backward' END AS phase,g.id AS gpu_annotation_id,(g.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS start_ms,g.dur/1e6 AS duration_ms FROM gpucomm g JOIN host h ON h.id=g.host_id ORDER BY g.ts

WITH target AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN id IN (587,21959,43593) THEN 'forward' ELSE 'backward' END AS phase FROM slice WHERE id IN (587,21959,43593,21566,43276,64911))
SELECT a.id,a.phase,(a.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS start_ms,(a.ts+a.dur-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS end_ms,a.dur/1e6 AS duration_ms,COALESCE(SUM(MAX(0,MIN(a.ts+a.dur,k.ts+k.dur)-MAX(a.ts,k.ts))),0)/1e6 AS stream7_kernel_overlap_ms,(a.dur-COALESCE(SUM(MAX(0,MIN(a.ts+a.dur,k.ts+k.dur)-MAX(a.ts,k.ts))),0))/1e6 AS no_stream7_kernel_ms FROM target a LEFT JOIN slice k ON k.category='kernel' AND k.track_id=3 AND k.ts<a.ts+a.dur AND k.ts+k.dur>a.ts GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.ts

WITH target AS (SELECT * FROM slice WHERE id IN (587,21959,43593,21566,43276,64911)) SELECT a.id AS annotation_id,k.id AS kernel_id,k.name,(k.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS start_ms,k.dur/1e6 AS duration_ms FROM target a JOIN slice k ON k.category='kernel' AND k.track_id=a.track_id AND k.ts>=a.ts AND k.ts+k.dur<=a.ts+a.dur ORDER BY a.ts,k.ts

WITH target AS (SELECT * FROM slice WHERE id IN (563,21938,43572,20266,41839,63503,21468,43129,64775))
SELECT a.id,a.name,(a.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS host_start_ms,k.id AS kernel_id,k.name AS kernel,(k.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS kernel_start_ms,k.dur/1e6 AS kernel_ms
FROM target a JOIN descendant_slice(a.id) l ON l.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver') AND l.name IN ('cudaLaunchKernel','cuLaunchKernel','cuLaunchKernelEx')
JOIN slice k ON k.category='kernel' AND EXTRACT_ARG(k.arg_set_id,'args.correlation')=EXTRACT_ARG(l.arg_set_id,'args.correlation') ORDER BY a.ts,k.ts
